source_refs.note: Responses to Cooling (Hypothermia): a main subheading of 13.3.3 Thermoregulation in Humans, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 8-11.

blocks.text: When body temperature falls below 37°C (hypothermia), the responses may include vasoconstriction, shivering and increase in metabolic rate. Vasoconstriction reduces blood flow to the skin and so there is less loss of heat from blood. Shivering (spasmodic contraction of skeletal muscles) produces heat which helps to raise the body temperature. Tiny muscles at the base of hair follicles contract (goosebumps). Air is trapped in the erected hair and act as insulator for the heat. Increased metabolic rate also produces heat to raise the body temperature.

blocks.alt: Two loops around a see-saw 'Body Temp. 37 C (homeostasis)'. Upper loop: body temperature increases above normal; receptors in skin and hypothalamus detect it; the control centre in the hypothalamus acts on effectors, sweat production and vasodilation; temperature decreases to normal. Lower loop: temperature decreases below normal; receptors detect it; the control centre acts on vasoconstriction and shivering; temperature increases to normal.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.5: Thermoregulation in humans (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 13.5).
blocks.long_description: Each loop runs from a stimulus box through 'Receptors (in skin & hypothalamus) detect stimulus' and 'Information sent to control centre.' to a brain with the hypothalamus marked, then to the effectors and a response box. Hot loop effectors: a skin section with a coiled sweat gland and a drop on the surface, 'Sweat production: Cooling by evaporation.', and a skin section with widened vessels near the surface and heat arrows, 'Vasodilation: Heat radiated from skin surface.'. Cold loop effectors: a skin section with narrow, deeper vessels, 'Vasoconstriction: Blood diverted to deep tissues to minimize heat loss.', and skeletal muscle fibres, 'Shivering in skeletal muscles: Heat produced.'. Both see-saw ends are marked 'Imbalance'.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The printed Figure 13.5 has the slips 'Cooling by evaporates', 'increases than normal' and 'decreases than normal'; the drawing above reads 'Cooling by evaporation', 'above normal' and 'below normal'.
